Maya Li: Quick note — Meridian QBR scheduled Tue 3/31 10:00 PT. We need slides + a 5-min exec 'health spotlight' and top 3 asks. Can we do a 30min dry run Fri?
Alex Ramos: Slide deck link -> https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1MeridianQBR (starter). I'll drop current metrics on slide 2.
Priya Singh: I can take Renewal Risks & Success Metrics (slide 3). I'll include the retention cohort chart and top 2 upsell blockers.
Tom O'Neill: Can eng share the API latency/uptime snapshot? small gif or chart would be great.
Nina Park: I'll own onboarding status & enablement (slide 4). Quick bullets: 72% activated, 4 blockers: SSO, webhook mapping, token rotation, docs gap.
Alex Ramos: @Tom O'Neill — pinged infra for last 7-day p95 and incident summary.
qbr-bot: Reminder: deck due by Fri 5pm PT. Please update speaker notes.
Maya Li: Exec asks: 1) confirmation of SLA roadmap, 2) decision on Dedicated capacity for Q3 pilot, 3) approval to extend onboarding enablement retainer. Need owners + exact wording for slides.
Priya Singh: Draft ask wording: 'Approve Q3 Dedicated pilot for Meridian — 4-week reserved capacity to validate latency SLOs.'
Nina Park: Enablement ask: 'Greenlight $15k enablement retainer for customized onboarding workshops (3 sessions) to close SSO & webhook mapping gaps.'
Alex Ramos: I'll add a "What we need from execs" slide with yes/no ask buttons and expected decisions.
Tom O'Neill: API snapshot: p95 = 220ms, uptime 99.94% last 30d. I'll add to notes + attach incident list.
Maya Li: Risk flags: Renewal signal at 68% (down from 82). Need a 2-slide remediation plan and exec decision list.
Priya Singh: I'll prepare remediation bullets and an owner map. Suggest canaries: 1) extra onboarding resource, 2) trial Dedicated pool.
Nina Park: For dry run Fri 2:00 PT — can everyone be there? I can do 30m.
Alex Ramos: Fri 2 works. I'll do slides + update deck.
Tom O'Neill: I'll be there. will upload chart gif by Thu EOD.
Maya Li: Action items (quick):
- Alex: update deck + metrics slide (due Thu 5pm)
- Priya: draft remediation slides + ask wording (due Thu 5pm)
- Tom: API snapshot + incident blurb (due Thu EOD)
- Nina: onboarding bullets + workshop outline (due Thu 5pm)
- Maya: assemble exec notes + send calendar invite for Fri dry run (due Wed EOD)

Please react with :white_check_mark: once you accept your item.
Alex Ramos: ✅
